# vaultwarden_user (Resource)

This resource invites a user to the Vaultwarden server.

Requires `admin_token` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vaultwarden_user" "example" {
  email = "foo@example.com"
}

# Keep the user, but block their logins
resource "vaultwarden_user" "disabled" {
  email   = "bar@example.com"
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email of the user to invite. Changing it deletes the user, including their vault if they accepted the invitation, and invites the new email.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user can log in. Disabling a user also logs them out of all their devices. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the user

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vaultwarden_user.example <id>
```
